pick.headline: Bomb explodes beneath the World Trade Center
pick.summary: On February 26, 1993, a truck bomb exploded in the garage beneath the World Trade Center in New York, killing six people.
pick.significance: The bombing, organized by Ramzi Yousef, was the first major foreign terrorist attack on US soil.
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of March 1, 1993, carried Belgrade RTB television: Radovan Karadzic dismissed a claim that a "Serbian Liberation Front" bombed New York's World Trade Center, saying Serbs did not want a military intervention and the investigation should be awaited.
